---
id: caribou
title: Caribou
---
Barren-ground caribou (*Rangifer tarandus*) leave the boreal forest after
winter and walk onto Arctic calving grounds as the snow recedes, then
reverse the track toward lichen pastures when insects and freeze-up push
them south. Some herds span a subcontinent on that return. Antlers occur
in both sexes; hollow hair insulates. Wolves and weather shape calf
survival.
